Imaginary numbers are [[number]]s that are multiples of $i$.

== Formal definition ==

Define the '''imaginary unit''' $i$ as the number that satisfies $i=\sqrt{-1}$, then any number

$$
I=ai,\, a \in \mathbb{R}
$$

is an '''imaginary number'''. The set of all imaginary numbers is denoted by $\mathbb{I}$.
